cases.regulation_text: Article 46(1) GDPR: In the absence of an adequacy decision pursuant to Article 45(3), a controller or processor may transfer personal data to a third country only if the controller or processor has provided appropriate safeguards, and on condition that enforceable data subject rights and effective legal remedies for data subjects are available.

contracts.name: Transatlantic User Telemetry & Data Processing Agreement
clauses: Section 8.2 (Data Flow): Customer agrees that European user behavioral telemetry, hashed identifiers, and ad interaction records shall be continuously streamed and stored in US-based central processing facilities without supplementary standard contractual clauses or secondary cryptographic transfer mechanisms.

cases.regulation_text: FTC Enforcement Standards & Safeguards Rule: Entities storing non-public consumer credit data must deploy reasonable patch management protocols within 48 hours for critical CVEs and notify affected parties without unreasonable delay.

contracts.name: Consumer Credit Bureau Scoring & Vendor API Contract
clauses: Section 14.1 (Vulnerability Management): Critical server framework patches shall be scheduled during quarterly routine maintenance windows. Vendor disclaims liability for unpatched legacy Apache Struts components during the quarterly cycle.

cases.regulation_text: BTRC Telecom Directives: Mobile Network Operators must maintain a minimum call drop rate below 1.5% and 4G throughput of 7 Mbps across all upazilas; failure to maintain minimum QoS warrants regulatory suspension of SIM card sales.

contracts.name: Tower Infrastructure & Core RAN Maintenance Agreement
clauses: Clause 6.3 (SLA Tolerance): Tower provider shall guarantee uptime with allowable call drop peaks up to 4.5% during peak congestive hours in rural district clusters.
